scenes.text: In twelve years, humanity went from orbit to the Moon.
Sputnik, Gagarin, then a race nobody was sure could be won.
And in July 1969, two people walked on another world.

milestones.title: Sputnik 1
milestones.fact: The first artificial satellite beeps from orbit.

milestones.title: Yuri Gagarin
milestones.fact: First human in space, 108 minutes in orbit.

milestones.title: John Glenn orbits
milestones.fact: The US puts an astronaut in orbit.

milestones.title: Apollo 8
milestones.fact: First crew to orbit the Moon.

milestones.title: Apollo 11
milestones.fact: Armstrong and Aldrin land on the Moon.
